steps.name: published through the real admin handlers (submit, a different admin approves with the summary hash, publish)

manual review and the executable tier are recorded for the hook

capabilities (as served by this harness) mark only hook:declarative supported
the install plan is elevated and executable (native confirmation required)
installed: state enabled, ledger entry written by hermes, stored rules present
the install reports the event mapping honestly (before_document_edit is derived)
the gateway offers the docx MCP tool to the model
the hook BLOCKED the confidential edit: the model saw the block message as the tool result
the stub tool never ran for the blocked call
the audit log has the block line (no argument values)
a non-matching edit goes through (the hook only blocks what it names)
installed while the gateway runs: "Restart the assistant to activate", not enabled
the late hook does not fire before a restart (no audit line for it)
the server revokes the version (moderator)
reconcile marks the item revoked and disabled on the device
the adapter revoke (what Task 14 wires into reconcile) marks the ledger revoked and removes the stored rules
after the revoke the SAME gateway process lets the edit through (hook inert, no restart)
the audit log records why the hook stopped
uninstall leaves no applied artefact (ledger entries and stored rules gone)
no process started by this run is left
